description: This Java class, named WavePanelSandbox, is a test or sandbox utility for visualizing engine waveform data. It extends a helper class for frames, creates UI components to display engine sniffer data, processes a large string report of engine events, extracts specific timing information between given bounds, and prints corresponding trigger events. The main method ensures the UI runs on the Event Dispatch Thread.
